abstract: The incidence of cysts in pregnancy was established with ultrasound. In 3,330 pregnant patients who underwent sonography, 38 adnexal cystic lesions (1.14%) were found. All but two cysts were discovered before 16 weeks. Follow-up showed that the majority of the cystic lesions resolved spontaneously; these were presumed to represent corpus luteum cysts. Five patients underwent surgery because of persistent cystic lesions; a mucinous cystadenoma, a benign cystic teratoma, a paraovarian cyst, an inclusion cyst, and a tuboovarian abscess were found. Septations and echogenic material were seen within the cystic teratoma and the tuboovarian abscess but the sonographic features of the other operated lesions were identical to those seen in the corpus luteum cysts.
abstract_ja: 妊娠中の嚢胞の発生率を超音波検査により明らかにした。妊娠中の3,330例に超音波検査を実施し、38例（1.14%）に付属器の嚢胞性病変を認めた。2例を除くすべての嚢胞は妊娠16週以前に発見された。フォローアップの結果、多くの嚢胞性病変は自然消退し、黄体嚢胞と考えられた。持続性の嚢胞性病変により5例が手術を受け、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、良性嚢胞性奇形腫、傍卵巣嚢胞、封入嚢胞、卵管卵巣膿瘍が認められた。嚢胞性奇形腫および卵管卵巣膿瘍の内部には隔壁と高エコー物質が認められた。その他の手術対象病変の超音波所見は、黄体嚢胞に見られるものと同一であった。
